title.zh: 【币安宣布暂停 Alpha 交易，将在解决安全问题后恢复】
title.en: 【币安宣布暂停 Alpha 交易，将在解决安全问题后恢复】

current_state.zh: Binance temporarily suspended Binance Alpha trading — including spot-wallet CEX buys, Alpha instant trading and CEX prediction markets — citing a security issue it said must be resolved before resuming, while stating user funds remain safe.
